name: Equatorial island mountains
reference_site: Generic equatorial 4000 m (Carstensz base camp ~4300 m, Kinabalu summit plateau ~4000 m)
sources: Prentice, M. & Hope, G. (2006) Climate of Papua (Carstensz glaciers). In: The Ecology of Papua
Kincaid, J. & Klein, A. (2004) Retreat of the Irian Jaya glaciers from 2000 to 2002. Eastern Snow Conference
Hersbach, H. et al. (2020) The ERA5 global reanalysis. QJRMS 146:1999-2049 (monthly climatology 1991-2020, 300 hPa winds)
notes: Rain or sleet almost daily, usually from late morning; climbs start before dawn. Kinabalu is warmer (lower).
